answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a one-time eFUSE burned into a physical chip at registration: the burn lays down an irreversible pigment of silicon that can never be rewritten, so every clone needs its own real chip. The ledger stores one fuse-hash per identity; duplicates collide and are rejected, stranding a fake fleet on a single island of hardware. An unbroken thread of signed fuse-attestations each epoch proves the chip still exists, so idle clones cannot be stockpiled.
